name: Per-Pixel Linked List Voxelization
aliases: Shader Storage Buffer Object Linked List Voxelization
definition: A GPU-based voxelization technique that constructs a linked list of fragment depths per pixel using atomic counters and shader storage buffers, allowing for subsequent sorting and processing of depth-sorted voxels.
summary: Per-Pixel Linked List Voxelization is a GPU technique that builds depth-sorted fragment lists per pixel using atomic counters, differing from multisample methods by preserving individual depths for accurate voxelization.
